results.market_gap: Horizontal tools found, but no direct Türkiye water/wastewater EPC + OSB evidence/submission product.
results.mvp: Requirement matrix, owner/deadline, evidence attachments, completeness gate, technical evidence register, pack index.
results.working_logic: Tender clauses -> requirements -> owners -> evidence -> gate -> submission pack.
results.marketing_strategy: Direct outreach to Turkish industrial water/wastewater EPC bidders using live OSB tenders as demos.
results.first_customer_plan: Build a Beyşehir tender demo and approach 10 EPC/equipment bidders.
results.main_risk: Horizontal vendors can verticalize; zero-cost MVP needs manual tender text input.
results.validation_assumption: 3 of 10 bid teams confirm recurring costly evidence gaps.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Evrensekiz OSB in Lüleburgaz tendered a 22,200 m3/day industrial wastewater treatment plant with the same evidence-heavy EPC bid workflow.
